set.body:
PlotComposition.column splits rows equally; linked strips (30 px VIF strip over a 420 px matrix over contrast strips) need explicit row heights (pt or weights) and a shared discrete x scale so columns align exactly.
Acceptance: three stacked panels with unequal heights share column boundaries to the device pixel in JavaFX and SVG.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: [Intaglio] Composition with explicit row heights and a shared discrete x frame
